• Run and improve our Kubernetes clusters on AWS
  • Write Terraform modules so every service gets the same safe defaults
  • Build deployment tooling and CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, in Go and Python
  • Set up monitoring and alerting with Prometheus and Grafana
  • Take part in the on-call rotation and lead blameless incident reviews

• 3+ years of experience in platform, DevOps or backend engineering
  • Production experience with Kubernetes and AWS
  • Comfort writing Go or Python for tools and services
  • Experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
  • A habit of writing down what you learn
